GET STARTED

Your first steps.

A clear path from learning about the project to installing the app.

STEP 01 / 05BEFORE YOU DOWNLOAD

Start with the essentials.

This is an independent community project bringing GTA V to supported Apple devices. Releases, requirements, and support are shared through our community.

RECOMMENDED READINGRead the project overview

Know what you are installing

You will need your own legally obtained game files. The launcher download does not replace them.

STEP 02 / 05BEFORE YOU DOWNLOAD

Make sure your device is ready.

Use your saved device profile to review hardware and memory considerations before downloading. Check the current build requirements as well.

RECOMMENDED READINGCheck compatibility

Review memory and storage

Installed RAM is not the memory available to the game. Signing entitlements, iOS, and free storage matter.

STEP 03 / 05BEFORE YOU DOWNLOAD

Read the setup guide first.

Learn how to sign the IPA, arrange the game folder, and prepare the files required by your build. Follow the instructions in order.

RECOMMENDED READINGRead installation guide

Keep your existing data safe

Before updating, keep a backup of saves and review whether your build needs a patch or additional files.

STEP 04 / 05BEFORE YOU DOWNLOAD

Know what changed.

Read the latest release notes and the instructions attached to the download. Some updates require more than reinstalling the IPA.

RECOMMENDED READINGRead release notes

Follow the selected build’s instructions

Check patch and movies requirements. Keep the build name handy if you need support.

STEP 05 / 05DOWNLOAD & SUPPORT

Continue in the community.

Join our Discord community to find the current launcher download and its setup instructions. Download availability and build requirements are maintained there.

FINAL DESTINATIONGo to community

Download through the community

Use the release information shared in the server. If you need help, include your device, iOS version, and build.
